svg.aria-label: Use Null. Control+Space: Show or hide the box Enter: Send a message, or choose a list entry Esc: Close a picker, cancel sign-in, or hide the box Ctrl+C: Stop the reply; when idle, quit and close the conversation, after one warning if others are still working ↑: Recall the last prompt in an empty field / then Enter: List the box's commands, each with a few words Drag: Move the box; click away hides it The arrow pulses while the agent works and turns amber when it asks. The pet beside the box shows the same, hops once when a reply ends and sinks when one fails. The transcript grows to about ten lines, then scrolls. Hiding the box does not stop a reply, and neither does /new or opening another conversation: it goes on working, the pet speaks for it, and /history lists it first.
